L'Esprit Critique est un podcast francop: L'Esprit Critique is a French-language podcast devoted to rational thinking, skepticism and the scientific mindset. It tackles cognitive biases, conspiracy theories and received ideas with rigour and clear teaching. A demanding format for listeners keen to better understand how their own thinking works.
L'Esprit Critique était-il fait pour êtr: Was L'Esprit Critique made to be reviewed by a critique podcast? The mise en abyme didn't escape Lolo and Alex. They look at how a scientific-skepticism podcast builds its authority, handles popularisation without sacrificing rigour, and keeps a demanding community loyal.
